scope: Forge control/CPU meter failure family; one shared runtime defect (five assertions) and two fixture corrections (redstone direction; CPU meter standby budget).

runtime_fix.before: Proxy reported its own removal state and hardcoded feature flags independently of the target.
runtime_fix.after: available/supportsSwitch/supportsProgress/supportsMode resolve current target via existing controlOperation and cycle guard; absent/unloaded/cyclic target returns false.

fixture_fix.change: Weak/direct signal queries use the opposite of installed cover face, matching Minecraft query convention and existing PanelCoverTests. Check uncovered opposite face is zero. Supply four 512-EU packets for two periods (40 ticks * 24 EU plus a 192-EU scan threshold) and explicitly assert late scan energy. Retain CPU usage, visual, idle-clear and NBT/sync assertions.
